historical_coverage.statement: 100% historical universe coverage is NEVER claimed; the historically unobservable newcomer population is an explicit residual (OTHER) mass in every allocation

historical_evaluation_split.HISTORICALLY_OBSERVABLE_CANDIDATES: rows of the point-in-time universe: scored as player rows
historical_evaluation_split.HISTORICALLY_UNOBSERVABLE_NEWCOMERS: producers that were not candidates: cannot be scored as rows (their non-producing roster peers are unknowable historically); their production is the residual OTHER mass whose size is learned from training seasons and which the coherent allocation reserves (carries / receptions / attempts), so team totals stay conserved

forward_universe.rule: every player on the timestamped live roster snapshot (skill positions) is a candidate even with zero prior appearances; the roster snapshot may add candidates but never silently drops a participant
forward_universe.wide_uncertainty: unseen players receive the generic prior with a much lower concentration (kappa) than seen players, so their count distributions are wide
prior_inputs_supported: current team environment (team volume, pass rate, rating)
transfer history when a stable provider id has earlier appearances for another team (prior-school per-appearance rates, shrunk)
generic position prior (league newcomer production share by position from the audit)

simulator_policy: each team-game keeps an explicit OTHER bucket per opportunity type (carries, receptions, pass attempts): candidates plus OTHER sum to the team total draw by draw; OTHER's expected share is the training-window share of production by non-candidates (position-group specific)
calibration_note: forward newcomer priors cannot be validated historically (no roster history): they enter forward shadow as uncalibrated high-uncertainty priors and are evaluated only on clean-forward evidence
